scope: Matched short optimization screen on old six-engine development features; not candidate acceptance or a v38 comparison.
architecture: Original local transfer60 folded-bias graph, 335-frame context, 25831 parameters. Distinct from GPU teacher60/150 and v38.
sampling: Uniform training engine then uniform row; positive valid jitter15..27, negative uniform complete crop; ambient uniform training row/start. Both arms reset the identical RNG and use identical full batch bytes; no mining or augmentation changes.

arms.five_mean: BCE of mean of five consecutive scores

validation: Old validation only: sort original source SHA per engine/label, first16 source IDs (all if fewer), variants0/3, whole original feature sequence. No testing rows or new/final datasets accessed.
threshold_origin: Previously used historical float validation grid endpoint for the fixed local warm start. Fixed descriptive operating point; no search or acceptance selection.
evaluation: Initial model and fixed step500 of each arm; no intermediate checkpoint/model/threshold selection. Save all mature-context score traces and fixed-policy events, any-hit and existing estimated-end window counts, by engine. No hardware or acoustic latency inference.
preflight: On first training batch, shared sequence/window scores must match within1e-4 before any optimization. A separate --smoke executes two steps per arm without validation scoring; its result cannot replace final screen.
limits: Small correlated already-consumed synthetic development subset and a single initialization/seed; neither human generalization nor statistical superiority is established.
Batched valid-convolution scorer covers mature receptive fields, not initial stream buffers; actual exported INT8/whole-stream/P4/FAR verification remains required.
Positive endpoint is the old metadata proxy; jitter supports five windows after it but does not certify phonetic completeness.
No PCM generation, playback, microphone recording, device/firmware/settings change or production-board access.
